description_en: Queries the access points of Express Connect circuits in a specified region by calling the DescribeAccessPoints operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeAccessPoints接口查询指定地域中的物理专线接入点
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-access-points --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accept-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccessPoints

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the access point.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
接入点所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.
en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。
en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

AccessPointType.description_en: The information about the access points

items.description_en: The information about the access points

AccessPointFeatureModel.description_en: The feature models of the access point
AccessPointFeatureModel.description_zh: 查询到的接入点特征模型

items.description_en: The feature models of the access point
items.description_zh: 查询到的接入点特征模型

FeatureKey.description_en: The feature key of the access point

AccessPointId.description_en: The ID of the access point

AttachedRegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the access point

HostOperator.description_en: The carrier to which the access point belongs

Location.description_en: The location of the access point

Name.description_en: The name of the access point

Status.description_en:
The status of the Express Connect circuit access point.

recommended: The access point is in good condition and is recommended.
hot: A large number of Express Connect circuits are connected to the access point. The access point is functioning properly.
full: The access point has reached its capacity. No more Express Connect circuits can be connected.
disabled: The access point is unavailable
Status.description_zh:
物理专线的接入点状态。

recommended ：表示接入点状态良好，推荐接入。
hot ：表示接入的物理专线较多，状态正常。
full ：表示接入物理专线已满，不允许新增接入。
disabled ：表示接入点不可用

Type.description_en: The network type of the Express Connect circuit. Default value: VPC
Type.description_zh: 物理专线的网络类型。默认值：VPC

PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
